A função do Analista de Infraestrutura atuará na configuração, operação e monitoramento de redes corporativas(LAN, WAN, WLAN) com foco em alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança. Garantir a segurança da informação em todas as camadas da infraestrutura, incluindo firewalls, VPNs, proxies, NAC, IDS/IPS, WAF e demais mecanismos de proteção. Conduzir análises de vulnerabilidades, propor e implementar ações corretivas/preventivas em ambientes críticos.
 

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Atuar no planejamento, configuração, operação e monitoramento de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN) com foco em alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança.
  • Garantir a segurança da informação em todas as camadas da infraestrutura, incluindo firewalls, VPNs, proxies, NAC, IDS/IPS, WAF e demais mecanismos de proteção.
  • Conduzir análises de vulnerabilidades, propor e implementar ações corretivas/preventivas em ambientes críticos.
  • Elaborar políticas de segurança, procedimentos operacionais e planos de resposta a incidentes.
  • Apoiar os squads em demandas que envolvam arquitetura de redes seguras,segmentação de tráfego, políticas de acesso e mitigação de riscos.
  • Monitorar eventos de segurança e atuar na investigação de incidentes, coordenando a resposta junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Participar da homologação de novas tecnologias, validação de soluções e testes de segurança.
  • Estruturar projetos com a metodologia mais adequada (Ágil, Tradicional ou Híbrida), conforme escopo e criticidade da iniciativa.

title: Senior Financial Accountant, LATAM
description:
TGS provides scientific data and intelligence to companies active in the energy sector. In addition to a global, extensive and diverse energy data library, TGS offers specialized services such as advanced processing and analytics alongside cloud-based data applications and solutions.

We a looking for a Senior Financial Accountant to join our team in Rio, Brazil. As our Senior Financial Accountant, you will be responsible for the finance functions of the entities in Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Uruguay and other LA Countries as relevant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable functions: Control AP routines, working closely with financial team on BPO of LA entities, ensuring accurate financial records, including proper allocation, meeting deadlines and complying with TGS group policies and procedures, including reconciliations between local and group systems.  
  • Billing/Accounts Receivables functions: Control Invoicing/AR routines, working closely with financial team on BPO of LA entities, ensuring accurate financial records, including proper allocation, meeting deadlines and complying with TGS group policies and procedures, including reconciliations between local and group systems.  Work closer to COP, providing any support needed as well as monitoring cash collections for LA entities, ensuring local and group systems to be updated and reconciled. 
  • Internal/External Reports functions: Control deadlines and prepare Brazil local content documentation to certificate the contracts within this requirement. Provide any financial report requested by Management or other areas within the organization.
  • Cash Management functions: Constant management of cash flow position and relationship with local banks for LA.
  • Audit functions: Support on internal and external audit by providing all necessary documentation and information required for LA entities.
  • Administrative functions: Ensure compliance, controlling deadlines of PoAs, certificates and any institutional requirements.

Key Competencies

  • Qualified Brazilian Accountant  with over 10 years of experience and an active Accountant Certificate, with strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting standards, paralegal compliance, tax laws, and local content requirements.
  • Broad financial expertise  including treasury operations, bank relations, audits, and use of ERP systems and financial tools for Latin America.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented , with strong problem-solving skills and accuracy in execution.
  • Effective communicator  with experience collaborating across all organizational levels, fluent in English and intermediate in Spanish.

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.

Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.

RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.

Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.

LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.

Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.

The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.

These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.

Location: we have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What you will focus on

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions

What we are looking for in you

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

title: ESG and Sustainability Lead
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As Subject Matter Expert on Sustainability (ESG), for your discipline and assigned Projects/Operations Readiness, you are responsible for ensuring prevention and mitigation of risks to our personnel, assets, the environment and our Company reputation, and for ensuring compliance with all standards, rules and other requirements imposed by Company, Regulators, Clients and other relevant Stakeholders.

    • Responsibilities


  • You support the Management in driving the education, communication, and implementation of the ESG management system as part of the execution phase.
  • You support SBM Group in developing a robust suite of ESG & Sustainability-related management systems in line with international standards and guidelines for project execution.
  • You ensure the collection, analysis, and reporting on ESG & Sustainability topics.
  • You are the focal point for your discipline on Social topics, both internally in support of our Turnkey Projects, Operation Readiness, and externally to the clients, contractors, and vendors.
  • You complete pre-tender human rights audits of major subcontractors.
  • You review potential subcontractor bid technical evaluations for compliance with project social requirements.
  • You lead Social assessments/studies in liaison with the Project Manager to ensure the correct integration of such into the project.
  • You manage all social initiatives on the project in conjunction with Clients throughout the project execution.
  • You contribute to the project progress report concerning all social activities in liaison with Group Sustainability and support emissions data collection for the project.
  • You lead the activities related to your discipline to provide effective support to Projects and/or Operation Readiness as necessary.
  • You prepare, implement, and update the Social and Emissions aspects of the HSSE Plans/Project Execution Plans.
  • You implement and monitor the Social and Emissions aspects management system, plans, and procedures.
  • You provide ESG & Sustainability practices and policy training to appropriate site, warehouse, laboratory, and office personnel, ensuring relevant employees and contractors receive appropriate training.
  • You may act as a Social Performance/Human Rights SME (Subject Matter Expert) for external stakeholders.

    • Education


  • Master's Degree in Environment, Sustainability, Engineering, Business or equivalent

    • Experience


  • Experience in HSSE, Social Performance & Sustainability · Project Management skills · Knowledge Compliance and international laws.
  • Experience in designing and implementing successful programs, campaigns and initiatives.

    • Functional Competencies


    Commercial Organizational culture Monitoring performance and compliance Diversity and inclusion Learning from events Human Rights Management Internal Audit Delivery Environmental Management

It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

title: Web Frontend Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Web/UI Engineer to develop a data-rich and reliable user experience. These frontends are constructed using JS, CSS, React, and Flutter, and serve as Canonical's enterprise products that act as the company's face to our users. 

In order to create consistency across our products and sites, we have a central team that builds an open-source React toolkit and presentation layer, the Vanilla Framework. We are excited to develop this further and see if we can help more open-source projects build performant and accessible interfaces that respond well to diverse layouts. We use REST APIs for communication, and we consider API design an important part of the process.

Flutter is a new front-end technology that has the potential to unify our desktop and web development. We are growing the team's exposure to Flutter and have roles on both web and Ubuntu engineering for this specialism.

We hire developers with outstanding academic results and a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge web technologies. In these roles, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high-quality, front-end and back-end code while exhibiting technical leadership, exceptional design, and intuitive user experience.

Additionally, we encourage colleagues to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Design and implement well-tested and documented software in Web technologies or Flutter.
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • Deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner in interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Web technologies
  • Experience with and passion for Typescript, React or Flutter
  • An eye for accessibility and performance
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events for up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Attention to detail concerning user-centric UI development
  • REST API design, development and governance
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

De pessoas para pessoas

Acreditamos que, mais do que tecnologia, a transformação digital é sobre como as pessoas conduzem as mudanças nas empresas. E por entender isso, o fator humano é o que nos faz evoluir e modernizar processos.

Não é somente mais uma oportunidade... e sim um convite para você fazer parte dessa história. 

Na iblue Consulting você vai trabalhar com uma equipe multidisciplinar, que é responsável por alavancar o crescimento do negócio através das nossas pessoas.

Cuidado com as pessoas

Requirements

Estamos em busca de um DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK .NET - SENIOR com mais de 6 anos, com expertise comprovada em .NET e Integrações de Sistemas, que seja apaixonado por inovação e que esteja comprometido com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade. Se você tem experiência em metodologias ágeis, qualidade de código e se identifica com valores como colaboração e comprometimento, essa oportunidade é para você

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações internas que suportam a gestão de processos de propriedade intelectual e prazos críticos.
  • Participar da modernização de sistemas legados em .NET Framework 4.8 para versões mais recentes (.NET 6 e .NET 8), definindo padrões de arquitetura e boas práticas.
  • Implementar e consumir APIs (REST) com foco em escalabilidade, segurança, rastreabilidade e performance.
  • Otimizar consultas e rotinas no SQL Server (índices, tuning, planos de execução, normalização/desnormalização estratégica).
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários e, quando aplicável, integração) e apoiar a criação de uma cultura de qualidade contínua.
  • Monitorar aplicações (telemetria, logs estruturados, métricas de performance) e atuar proativamente em incidentes.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions ou similar).
  • Contribuir em code reviews, propondo padrões (clean code, SOLID, separação de camadas, uso eficiente de generics e async/await).
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, modelos de dados e integrações de sistemas.
  • Colaborar com áreas jurídicas para traduzir requisitos regulatórios e operacionais em soluções técnicas robustas.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective) e apoiar a melhoria contínua do processo.

PERFIL TÉCNICO

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com C# e plataforma .NET (mínimo: .NET Framework 4.8 e .NET Core 3.1; desejável vivência com .NET 6 ou 8).
  • Forte domínio de construção de APIs REST (controllers, DTOs, versionamento, tratamento de erros, autenticação/autorização).
  • Experiência com front-end em Angular (mínimo uma versão 8+; capacidade de atuar em projetos Angular 8 e 15).
  • HTML5, CSS3/SASS e TypeScript avançado (componentização, RxJS, interceptors, guards, change detection).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework / EF Core (mapeamento, migrações, desempenho, tracking vs no-tracking).
  • Banco de dados SQL Server: modelagem relacional, queries avançadas, stored procedures, otimização de índices e análise de planos de execução.
  • Conhecimento de mecanismos de segurança (JWT, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, proteção contra XSS/CSRF, hardening de APIs).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de build e deploy (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions ou similar) e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Uso de ferramentas de documentação e colaboração (Swagger / OpenAPI).

title: Especialista de Transportes e Logística
description:
DESCRIPTION


Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry.
Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third-party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast-paced environment — closer to a start-up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It's essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in-person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key job responsibilities
Manage end-to-end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.

Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.

Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.

Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.

Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.

Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.

Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.

Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life
The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and quality. It acts both tactically, analyzing metrics, and operationally, following the daily routine and resolving deviations on the ground. It works in collaboration with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. It is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, ensuring the best customer experience.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
  • English Skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with SQL

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Job Title:
Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department:
Sales

Role Summary

The
Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
will play a key role in M&O Partners' commercial growth by representing our suppliers' products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the
Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore
and working closely with the
Sales Manager
, this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O's solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers' products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O's presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors' positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O's objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.

Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise:
    Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management:
    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge:
    Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen:
    Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking:
    Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration:
    Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.

Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years
    of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the
    maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore
    sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with
    shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers
    .
  • Familiarity with
    procurement processes
    and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Graduate Customer Success Manager
description:
The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM)  are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap. 

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications. 

This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions. 

Location:  This role will be based remotely worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more. 
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team

What we are looking for in you

  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally 

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Site Reliability
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products.  If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary


The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.

Location: This role is available remotely in any timezone.

As a Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer engineer you will


  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Develop new features and improve the resilience and scalability of the existing cloud and container portfolio at Canonical
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

    • What we are looking for in you


  • A deep experience of, and knowledge to define operations in code, using version control, peer review and CI/CD to roll out changes both to applications and infrastructure
  • Strong modern engineering background (peer-review, unit testing, SCM, CI/CD, Agile)
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

title: Consultor(a) de Negócios
description:
Consultor(a) de Negócios (Preferencialmente para Mulheres) / PH / Rio de Janeiro - RJ  

     

A Bayer atende às nossas necessidades humanas mais básicas – saúde e alimentação.

Contribuímos para um mundo em que as doenças não são apenas tratadas, mas eficazmente prevenidas ou curadas; em que as pessoas possam cuidar da sua própria saúde de forma mais eficaz; em que sejam produzidos produtos agrícolas suficientes para todos, preservando simultaneamente os recursos naturais do nosso    planeta; em que o crescimento empresarial e a sustentabilidade andam de mãos    dadas.
Nossa missão é: Saúde para todos, Fome para ninguém. 

Nos comprometemos com diversidade em todos os aspectos para todos os colaboradores e candidatos. Sem distinção, seja por etnia, cor, raça, religião, origem, idade, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou outras condições. Lembrando que todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

CONHEÇA NOSSA ÁREA:

A Saúde Feminina é responsável por cuidar da mulher, através de modernos medicamentos que proporcionam melhor qualidade de vida para elas em todos os momentos de sua vida.

SUA MISSÃO SERÁ:

  • Elaborar planejamento de visitas e interações junto aos clientes médicos, HCPs e instituições, a fim de garantir frequência e sequência no seu cadastro de clientes, otimizando o tempo disponível para aplicá-lo em ações que revertam em resultados;
  • Garantir sua capacitação, cumprindo a agenda de treinamento, buscando atualização dos conhecimentos técnicos relacionados a nossos produtos e concorrentes, necessários para o desenvolvimento de suas funções (conhecimentos técnicos: anatomia, fisiologia, patologias, mecanismos de ação, posologia, efeitos adversos etc.);
  • Manter relacionamento ético com Líderes de opinião, Sociedades médicas, Secretárias de Saúde, Centros de referência, HCPs e parceiros comerciais;
  • Identificar as necessidades, construir e executar planos de ação em parceria com líder de contas e KAM de Acesso visando padronizar, instituir protocolos e gerar demanda da linha de produtos Bayer em Instituições Privadas;
  • Entender preferências e ativar os diversos canais de comunicação com clientes de maneira adequada e assegurando uma abordagem personalizada;
  • Acompanhar e analisar as auditorias de demanda com objetivo de elaborar e manter atualizado o plano de ação do território e garantir bons resultados;
  • Apoiar a organização e participar de webinars, simpósios, congressos e eventos (sejam presenciais ou virtuais) com o objetivo de divulgar os produtos e serviços, de acordo com as políticas e diretrizes da Bayer;
  • Documentar interações com clientes e manter o cadastro de instituições, médicos e HCPs atualizado, propondo revisões de acordo com as necessidades do negócio, através do sistema de CRM;
  • Zelar pelo patrimônio da empresa que está sob sua responsabilidade (veículo, pasta de trabalho, material promocional, equipamentos diversos);
  • Ter amplo conhecimento e cumprir as leis e Normas de Compliance, assegurando sustentabilidade;
  • Ter conhecimento e fazer bom uso das ferramentas digitais para as interações virtuais (MS Teams, Skype, Zoom, etc) tanto internamente (equipes da Bayer) como com clientes, assim como as ferramentas de CRM e de negociações.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

 Mandatório:

  • Graduação em área de negócios, área da saúde ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência no mercado privado;
  • Experiência comercial no mercado farmacêutico;
  • Conhecimento do mercado farmacêutico institucional;
  • Residir na cidade do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Conhecimento e experiencia com ferramentas digitais (CRM, Veeva, Office, MS Teams, Skype, Zoom, WhatsApp, Facetime, etc) tanto para uso interno como com clientes;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Desejável:

  • Sólido entendimento em ginecologia e saúde da mulher;
  • Preferencialmente formação em cursos da área da saúde.

O QUE MAIS VOCÊ ENCONTRA POR AQUI:

Na Bayer estabelecemos nossos benefícios em três pilares essenciais, que se integram e se convergem para promover a qualidade de vida e o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores.

  • Assistência Médica  
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Subsídio medicamentos  
  • GymPass
  • Conte Comigo - Assistência psicológica, dependência química, consultoria jurídica e financeira
  • Bem Nascer – um pacote recheado de benefícios exclusivos para novos papais e mamães, como por exemplo: uma cadeirinha veicular para garantir a segurança do bebê, Livro Personalizado "Enquanto eu Nascia", acompanhamento da saúde da mamãe e do bebê durante a gravidez, isenção de coparticipação, encontro com pais e gestantes, licença maternidade e paternidades estendida, auxílio creche, Bepantol baby, dentre outros.
  • Previdência Privada - Veículo de poupança de longo prazo que oferece 200% de contrapartida, carteira de empréstimos competitiva e promoção do bem-estar financeiro
  • Seguro de Vida
  • CoopBayer - Cooperativa que tem como objetivo a educação financeira dos colaboradores
  • *Short Friday e Escala de pontes e feriados
  • Flexibilização de férias (dentro do que é previsto na legislação)
  • **Clube Bayer - Facilidades do clube: churrasqueira, salão de jogos, piscina, academia, salão de festas e quadra de futebol)
  • *Home Office  
  • *Flex Time

*Pode haver alguma diferença no pacote de benefícios de acordo com o cargo e localidade.

**Mediante associação do colaborador.

title: Freelance Chemistry Expert with Python
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Chemistry, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Generate prompts that challenge AI.
  • Define comprehensive scoring criteria to evaluate the accuracy of the AI's answers.
  • Correct the model's responses based on your domain-specific knowledge.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD Degree in Chemistry and/or in relevant area.
  • You have at least 3 years of professional experience with the focus in one of the following fields: Analytical Chemistry, General Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • Proficiency in Python, with experience using libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas.
  • Strong ability to design creative and diverse problems, particularly those that are computationally intensive and go beyond simple parameter modifications.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $14/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Freelance Physics Expert
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Physics, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Generate prompts that challenge AI.
  • Define comprehensive scoring criteria to evaluate the accuracy of the AI's answers.
  • Correct the model's responses based on your domain-specific knowledge.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD Degree in Physics and/or in relevant area.
  • You have at least 1 year of professional experience with focus in one of the following fields: Astrophysics, Condensed Matter Physics, Electromagnetism and Photonics, High-energy particle physics, Optics and Acoustics, General Physics, Quantum Mechanics, Relativistic Mechanics, Statistical Mechanics.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $14/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;
  • Gestão jurídica contratual e ações relacionadas ao empreendimento;
  • Contribuir com a elaboração e principalmente execução do planejamento estratégico e orçamento plurianual do Shopping por meio de participação em comitês comerciais semanais e demais rotinas junto ao time de Analistas, Assistentes, Estagiário e Auxiliares;
  • Garantir a veracidade das informações e todos os KPIS da área comercial, que auxiliarão na tomada de decisão do Shopping através da consolidação e análise de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Maximizar os recursos disponíveis com o objetivo de rentabilizar todas as linhas de receita do empreendimento, principalmente as linhas ligadas aos resultados, assim como na otimização dos custos;
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas do time.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior Completo em administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência em negociação comercial;
  • Pacote Office avançado (especialmente Excel);
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Experiência sólida na área.

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Coordenação Técnica e Estratégica do Contencioso (Volume e Estratégico):
  • Coordenar a célula de contencioso da empresa, abrangendo tanto o contencioso de volume (alto número de processos com menor impacto individual) quanto os processos estratégicos e de maior risco financeiro ou reputacional.
  • Garantir uniformidade na atuação, alinhamento com diretrizes da empresa e qualidade técnica na condução dos processos.
  • Gestão da Equipe Jurídica Interna:
  • Liderar advogados, analistas e estagiários da área, distribuindo tarefas, prestando orientação técnica, promovendo treinamentos e avaliando performance individual e coletiva.
  • Supervisão de Escritórios Terceirizados:
  • Fiscalizar a atuação dos escritórios de advocacia parceiros, avaliando prazos, qualidade das peças e aderência à estratégia definida.
  • Atuar como interlocutor com escritórios para alinhar orientações jurídicas, estratégias de defesa e posicionamento institucional.
  • Condução e Coordenação de Acordos:
  • Avaliar e aprovar propostas de acordo com base em critérios jurídicos e financeiros.
  • Coordenar campanhas de conciliação e fomentar práticas de encerramento consensual dos litígios, visando redução de passivo.
  • Controle de Contingências e Provisões:
  • Supervisionar e orientar a classificação de risco dos processos (provável, possível, remoto) e o ajuste do valor do risco em conjunto com escritórios e equipe interna.
  • Garantir a atualização contínua das bases de contingência e suportar as áreas financeira e contábil em provisionamentos e auditorias.
  • Elaboração de Materiais para Governança:
  • Desenvolver relatórios executivos, apresentações estratégicas e matérias deliberativas para comitês e instâncias de governança.
  • Comunicar de forma clara os resultados da área de contencioso, impactos financeiros e planos de ação, visando engajamento da alta liderança.
  • Gestão Orçamentária de Contratos Jurídicos:
  • Acompanhar e controlar a execução orçamentária dos contratos com escritórios externos e prestadores de serviço jurídico.
  • Participar da negociação, revisão e aprovação de honorários, reajustes e aditivos contratuais, assegurando previsibilidade e eficiência na gestão de custos jurídicos.
  • Gestão por Indicadores e Melhoria Contínua:
  • Monitorar KPIs da área (ex.: taxa de êxito, tempo médio de encerramento, índice de acordos etc.), promovendo melhorias contínuas e inovações nos fluxos de trabalho.
  • Atualização Jurídica e Análise de Riscos:
  • Acompanhar mudanças legislativas e jurisprudenciais com impacto nos temas contenciosos relevantes à empresa, orientando a equipe sobre eventuais ajustes de estratégia.

Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Nível superior completo em Direito;
  • Inscrição na OAB;
  • Desejável pós graduação em processo civil;
  • Desejável familiaridade com sistemas de controle processual e ferramentas de gestão jurídica (BENNER);
  • Desejável ter experiência corporativa;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Excel, incluindo criação de planilhas, fórmulas e gráficos.

Informações adicionais
Benefícios:
Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

  • Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Vale-Transporte;
  • Wellhub;
  • Auxílio-creche;
  • Auxílio-educacional;

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já

title: operador cnc i
description:
Missão do cargo


Responsável por operar máquinas CNC, visando à usinagem de peças de baixa complexidade, de acordo com o desenho e plano de fabricação, utilizando programas CNC, ferramentas de corte e instrumentos de medição adequados, com objetivo de confeccionar peças com qualidade no menor tempo possível.

Descrição do cargo

  • Analisar e Usinar peças de baixa complexidade conforme as especificações, utilizando máquinas CNC, programa CNC, ferramentas de corte e instrumentos de medição adequados, a fim de atender o planejamento da produção;
  •  Preparar a máquina CNC, de acordo com o plano de fabricação para executar o serviço com qualidade e segurança dentro do tempo previsto;
  • Efetuar cálculos matemáticos e conversão de medidas para usinagem correta das peças, quando necessário;
  • Preencher toda documentação necessária ao processo, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas;
  • Verificar se a matéria-prima e o desenho da peça correspondem ao especificado no plano de fabricação e no plano de montagem, a fim de evitar problemas nas etapas de fabricação;
  • Manter máquinas e ferramentas de acordo com as condições básicas de manutenção e preceitos do programa de estabilidade básica do fluxo de valor a fim de garantir um ambiente com produção enxuta sem desperdícios e sem paradas;
  • Manter máquinas e ferramentas em bom estado de conservação, bem como zelar pela limpeza e organização do setor, de acordo com os preceitos do programa 5S;
  • Local: Pavuna - Rio de Janeiro.

Requisitos

  • Formação Técnica em mecânica;

title: Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring talented Software Engineers with strong Python, Packaging and Linux skills and who want to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap, rock and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps,  charms and more recently, rocks. 

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond. 

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you

title: Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.

What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure

  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code

  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies

  • Golang programming skills

description:
Necessário:
Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou campos relacionados.
Certificações como PMP (Project Management Professional) ou certificações ágeis como CSM (Certified ScrumMaster).
Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos de software, idealmente em ambientes que utilizam metodologias ágeis e em cascata. A experiência com projetos de RPA é um grande bônus.
Conhecimento em linguagens de programação, bancos de dados, arquitetura de software e, idealmente, em tecnologias específicas de RPA. Compreensão de CI/CD (Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua) e DevOps também pode ser relevante.
Capacidade de liderar equipes, gerenciar stakeholders, e comunicar-se eficazmente com equipes técnicas e não técnicas. Habilidades em resolver conflitos e em negociação são fundamentais.
Competência em gerenciar orçamentos, cronogramas e recursos de projetos.
Atividades a serem desempenhadas:
Definir o escopo do projeto, estabelecer objetivos e resultados esperados, planejar cronogramas, alocar recursos e definir métricas de sucesso.
Liderar e motivar a equipe de projeto, incluindo desenvolvedores, analistas de negócios, testadores e outros profissionais relacionados. Isso envolve a alocação de tarefas, a resolução de conflitos e a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.
Manter uma comunicação clara e regular com todas as partes interessadas, incluindo a equipe de projeto, a alta gerência, os clientes e outros departamentos envolvidos. Isso pode envolver a realização de reuniões de status, a preparação de relatórios de progresso e a negociação de requisitos e mudanças.
Acompanhar o progresso do projeto em relação ao plano estabelecido, incluindo o monitoramento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade. Identificar e mitigar riscos, gerenciar mudanças e garantir que os objetivos do projeto sejam alcançados.
Assegurar que os produtos ou serviços entregues atendam aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e às expectativas dos clientes.
Identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos potenciais que podem impactar o cronograma, o orçamento ou a qualidade do projeto.
Aplicar metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos, como Agile, Scrum ou Waterfall, dependendo das necessidades e da natureza do projeto.
Gerenciamento de Recursos como a gestão eficiente dos recursos humanos, financeiros, materiais e tecnológicos necessários para o projeto.
Monitorar o desempenho do projeto após a entrega, coletando feedback, realizando análises pós-projeto e garantindo que os benefícios planejados sejam alcançados.
Atividades de Pré-Venda: Compreensão das necessidades do cliente para então desenhar e propor soluções aderentes para resolução dos desafios de negócio incluindo a condução de provas de conceito, elaboração de propostas técnica e formação de preços.

title: AI & Product Development Specialist Internship In Bali
description:
AI & Product Development Specialist – Rio de Janeiro


Fund Size: €90M USD 


Location: Bali, Indonesia (with global impact) 


Focus: Future-builders, meaningful innovation 


Start: ASAP 


Important Note: This is an unpaid internship. We don't cover accommodation, food, visa, or flights. What do we offer? The chance to build skills that don't exist in textbooks, work on projects that matter, and live like the future leader you're meant to be. 


What You'll Do: Engineer AI systems that accelerate product innovation by predicting market needs, optimizing product features, and automating key aspects of the development process. You'll build machine learning models that can analyze customer feedback, usage patterns, and market trends to identify opportunities for new products or improvements to existing ones, while creating AI-powered testing frameworks that can rapidly validate product concepts and features. Your responsibilities include developing predictive models that can forecast product adoption and success rates, building AI systems that can generate and evaluate product ideas based on market analysis and user needs, and creating intelligent recommendation engines that can suggest optimal product configurations for different customer segments. You'll also architect automated A/B testing platforms that can continuously optimize product features, build AI tools that can analyze competitor products and identify differentiation opportunities, and develop user experience optimization systems that can personalize products for individual users. 


Why It's Cool: Product development is about to get an AI turbo boost, and you're building the systems that will create the next generation of breakthrough products. The AI you develop will help companies understand what customers really want before they even know it themselves, while accelerating the innovation process and reducing the risk of product failures. This is where market intelligence meets creative innovation, where you'll be developing technologies that can understand human needs and translate them into successful products. Your work will influence how the world's most innovative companies approach product development, and you'll be creating tools that help bring better products to market faster. 


Bali Option: Innovate breakthrough products from paradise, where the creative energy of Bali's startup ecosystem meets cutting-edge product development technology. Brainstorm AI-powered solutions with ocean views, prototype with your international innovation squad over beachside collaboration sessions, and find inspiration for your products in the innovative solutions you see local entrepreneurs creating. Attend product development workshops led by successful founders, network with product managers from around the world, and experience how the right environment can dramatically enhance both creativity and strategic product thinking.

title: AI & Data Insights Analyst Internship In Bali
description:
AI & Data Insights Analyst – Rio de Janeiro


Fund Size: €90M USD 


Location: Bali, Indonesia (with global impact) 


Focus: Future-builders, meaningful innovation 


Start: ASAP 


Important Note: This is an unpaid internship. We don't cover accommodation, food, visa, or flights. What do we offer? The chance to build skills that don't exist in textbooks, work on projects that matter, and live like the future leader you're meant to be. 


What You'll Do: Build AI systems that can find hidden patterns in massive datasets and transform raw information into strategic insights that drive critical business decisions. You'll develop machine learning algorithms that can analyze complex, multidimensional data to identify trends, correlations, and anomalies that human analysts might miss, while creating predictive models that can forecast future outcomes with high accuracy. Your work involves building automated insight generation systems that can continuously monitor data streams and alert stakeholders to important changes, developing natural language generation tools that can explain complex analytical findings in clear, actionable terms, and creating interactive visualization platforms that make data exploration intuitive and powerful. Additionally, you'll architect real-time analytics systems that can process streaming data and provide immediate insights, build AI-powered hypothesis testing frameworks that can validate or challenge business assumptions, and develop recommendation engines that can suggest optimal strategies based on data analysis. 


Why It's Cool: Data is the new oil, and you're building the most advanced refineries to extract maximum value from information. The AI systems you create will help organizations see patterns and opportunities that were previously invisible, turning data into competitive advantages and strategic insights. This is detective work for the digital age, where you'll be developing technologies that can understand complex relationships in data and translate them into actionable intelligence. Your work will influence how organizations make critical decisions, and you'll be creating the foundation for a more data-driven world where insights drive better outcomes. 


Bali Option: Uncover global data insights from your island base, where the clarity of tropical skies mirrors the clarity of insights you'll extract from complex datasets. Mine datasets with a tropical focus, share breakthrough discoveries with your analytics crew over beachside dinners, and find inspiration for your algorithms in the natural patterns and relationships you observe in island ecosystems. Attend data science workshops with ocean views, network with analytics professionals from around the world, and experience how the right environment can enhance both analytical thinking and creative problem-solving.

With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver AP US curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

Teachers should have experience teaching one or more of the following subjects:

  • AP Biology

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.

  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.

  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.

  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.

  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.

  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.

  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA's rich resource library.

  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in the subject area you wish to teach.

  • Experience teaching US grades 9-12 or teaching the subject area at the college level

  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.

  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the US AP Curricula

  • The ability to dedicate at least 15-20 hours weekly for 6-9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's or higher degree in education or subject area you wish to teach

  • State teaching license

  • Prior experience teaching Honors or AP courses

  • Experience in teaching students AP Exam Prep

About Crimson Global Academy:

CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.

  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.

  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child's education.

If you're passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now

To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

title: Estágio em Marketing
description:
SOBRE O CARGO

Buscamos por candidatos para a uma oportunidade de estágio na área de Marketing na SC Johnson. O candidato(a) precisa estar cursando ensino superior e ter disponibilidade para estagiar em nosso escritório na Barra da Tijuca/RJ.

EXPERIÊNCIA REQUERIDA

EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES DESEJADAS

  • Demonstrar um bom nível de comunicação escrita e falada
  • Bom de relacionamento interpessoal
  • Demonstrar perfil analítico

REQUISITOS

  • Disponibilidade para estagiar de 06h/dia entre 08h e 19h.
  • Contrato por tempo determinado
  • Essa posição não é elegível para realocação

BENEFÍCIOS

Junte-se à SC Johnson e faça parte de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar na América Latina com:

  • Escritórios e fábricas sustentáveis e inovadores, projetados com espaços abertos que inspirarão sua criatividade, equipados com as ferramentas necessárias para você aproveitar seu dia a dia.

SOBRE NÓS

A SC Johnson (SCJ) é uma empresa familiar que trabalha por um mundo melhor. É essa essência que move todas as suas atividades ao redor do mundo há 135 anos. Ao longo de sua história, se consolidou como um dos principais fabricantes mundiais de marcas para utilidades do lar, com produtos de alta qualidade em higiene, limpeza, armazenamento doméstico, purificadores de ar, controle de praga, entre outros. No Brasil, seu portfólio inclui marcas reconhecidas como Pato, Mr. Músculo, Lysoform, Glade, Raid, OFF, Exposis, Baygon e Ziploc.

Inclusion & Diversity

We're a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.
